segments.text: FICTIONAL RESIDENTIAL LEASE FOR SOFTWARE EVALUATION ONLY
This agreement is made between Marina Crest Holdings W.L.L. as landlord and Example Tenant Two as tenant.
The premises are unit MC-B-1204 at Marina Crest Residences, Tower B, Lusail.
The fixed term is twelve months. Commencement is 1 October 2026 and the last inclusive day is 30 September 2027.
The tenant shall pay QAR 8,500 each month. The stated annual rent is QAR 102,000.
A security deposit of QAR 8,500 is due before handover.
On each annual renewal the monthly rent shall increase by 3 percent.
A renewal request must be received in writing 60 days before expiry and any renewal lasts twelve months.
Either party must give 60 days written notice for termination subject to the fixed term.
All parties and signatures in this sample are fictional.
An additional rent schedule states that the monthly rent is QAR 9,000. Neither schedule is marked superseded.
